alerting.title: Alerting
alerting.forbidden.title: No access to alerting
alerting.forbidden.text: Your role in this organization cannot see alert rules. Ask an admin of your organization if you need them.
alerting.off.server: Alerting is off on this server: rules are kept but not evaluated.
alerting.off.org: Alerting is off in this organization: rules are kept but not evaluated.
alerting.rules.lead: Rules of this organization. They are evaluated as the service identity “Alerting”, only on data sources opted in to alerting.
alerting.rules.noInstances: No instances yet: the rule has not been evaluated.
alerting.rules.noInstancesPaused: Paused rules have no instances. Resuming starts everything at OK.
alerting.rules.footer: Sorted by state, then name. States are always written out; color only adds to them.
alerting.rules.footerReadOnly: Sorted by state, then name. Creating and changing rules needs the editor role.
alerting.rules.menu.label: Actions for “{name}”
alerting.rules.deleteText: The rule and its {count} instances are removed; firing instances are not reported as resolved. The history stays until the end of its retention ({days} days).
alerting.rules.deleteHint: Pause instead of deleting: instances end without a notification, and resuming starts everything at OK.
alerting.empty.title: No alert rules yet
alerting.empty.text: A rule evaluates a stored query regularly, reduces its result to a number and reports when its condition holds. The quickest way is from a panel: panel menu > “Create alert rule”.
alerting.empty.step1: Opt a data source in to alerting (data source > Alerting)
alerting.empty.step2: Add a contact point (mail or webhook)
alerting.empty.noSource: No data source is opted in to alerting yet. Whoever may edit data sources can do so (admins).
alerting.editor.title: Alert rule
alerting.editor.name: Name
alerting.editor.conflict: Someone saved this rule in the meantime ({name}, version {version}). Load their version, or save yours over it.
alerting.editor.queryHidden: You may neither read nor query this rule’s data source, so its query is hidden and the rule can only be viewed.
alerting.editor.panelChanged: The panel’s query changed since this rule copied it.
alerting.editor.noSources: No data source you may query is opted in to alerting. Whoever may edit a data source opts it in there.
alerting.editor.optedIn: Opted in to alerting · runs as the service identity “Alerting”
alerting.editor.notOptedIn: This data source is not opted in to alerting; the rule cannot be saved on it.
alerting.editor.frameHint.last: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. last takes the value with the latest time.
alerting.editor.frameHint.min: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. min takes the smallest value in the range.
alerting.editor.frameHint.max: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. max takes the largest value in the range.
alerting.editor.frameHint.mean: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. mean takes the average in the range.
alerting.editor.frameHint.sum: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. sum adds up the values in the range.
alerting.editor.frameHint.count: Each series becomes an instance with its labels. count takes the number of values in the range.
alerting.editor.countHint: The query decides which documents count. 0 documents is a value (OK), not missing data.
alerting.editor.fieldHint: Documents without the field do not count. A field holding text instead of a number gives the state Error, never a silent conversion.
alerting.editor.graphHint: One instance per rule. 0 nodes, edges or paths is a value, not missing data.
alerting.editor.conditionHint: Also: greater than or equal, less than, less than or equal, equal, unequal, outside of and inside of (two bounds, both included for inside).
alerting.editor.forHint: How long an instance stays “Pending” first; a multiple of the interval.
alerting.editor.noContactPoints: No contact points yet. An admin of the organization adds them.
alerting.editor.contactPointsHint: Choose from the existing contact points. New ones are added by an admin of the organization.
alerting.editor.error.pathsNoLabel: Paths are counted without a label.
alerting.editor.error.interval: The interval must be at least {min} seconds and at most one day.
alerting.editor.error.forMultiple: The “for” duration must be a multiple of the interval, at most one day.
alerting.editor.error.labelName: “{name}” cannot be a label name: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _, not alertname and not starting with __.
alerting.editor.error.labelValue: The label “{name}” needs a value of 1 to {max} characters.
alerting.preview.title: Preview
alerting.preview.idle: “Evaluate now” runs the rule as it stands, with your rights. Nothing is saved before “Save”.
alerting.preview.missing: The preview comes with the next server update; until then the rule is evaluated after saving.
alerting.preview.evaluatedAt: Evaluated at {time} with your rights. Nothing is saved before “Save”.
alerting.preview.noContacts: No contact point is chosen, so nothing would be sent.
alerting.preview.messageSample: After “Evaluate now”, the message shows the instances with their values.
alerting.preview.links: Open rule · Open panel · Silence · Runbook
alerting.preview.onlyValues: Only reduced values, never rows, documents or nodes from the result.
alerting.contact.leadAdmin: Where notifications go. Organization admins (alerts:contacts) add and change them.
alerting.contact.lead: Where notifications go. You choose contact points in your rules.
alerting.contact.readOnly: View only. Organization admins add and change contact points (permission alerts:contacts). If you need a new one, ask an admin of your organization.
alerting.contact.column.name: Contact point
alerting.contact.footerAdmin: A mail contact point needs a mail server (Administration > Email). A webhook is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the header Kalzit-Signature.
alerting.contact.footer: Recipients show only as a count and webhooks only with their host.
alerting.contact.menu.label: Actions for “{name}”
alerting.contact.testLimited: At most 5 tests a minute per contact point. Try again shortly.
alerting.contact.testMissing: Sending a test comes with the next server update.
alerting.contact.nameRequired: Give the contact point a name.
alerting.contact.recipientsHint: One email address per line, or separated by commas.
alerting.contact.urlHint: Private networks are allowed. Kalzit itself and metadata addresses never; redirects are not followed.
alerting.contact.secretHint: Shown only once. After renewing, the old one stays valid for 24 hours.
alerting.contact.secretAfterSave: Kalzit makes the signing secret when you save and shows it once.
alerting.contact.verifyHint: Reject timestamps older than 5 minutes. A test carries Kalzit-Event: test; at most 5 a minute.
alerting.contact.noMail: Mail needs a mail server. A server admin sets it up under Administration > Email. Until then only webhooks work.
alerting.contact.deleteText: Rules that notify it must choose another contact point first.
alerting.contact.secretText: Copy the secret into the receiver now. Kalzit does not show it again.
alerting.contact.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the secret and copy it by hand.
alerting.silences.lead: Silences hold back notifications, never the evaluation.
alerting.silences.noneExpired: No ended silences within the retention.
alerting.silences.endText: Notifications are sent again; an instance still firing is reported once.
alerting.silences.footer: When a silence ends while an instance still fires, it is reported once. Creating and ending silences is in the audit log.
alerting.silences.dialogLead: Evaluation goes on; matching instances are only not reported.
alerting.silences.fromInstance: Filled in from {labels}. Evaluation goes on; only reporting stops.
alerting.silences.label: Label
alerting.silences.matchersHint: Comparisons: =, ≠, =~ (regular expression over the whole value). alertname is the rule’s name.
alerting.silences.window: From now ({from}) to {to}. At most {days} days.
alerting.silences.affectedNone: Add a condition to see which instances it affects.
alerting.silences.affectedZero: Affects no instance right now. Saving is still possible, for planned work.
alerting.history.lead: Changes of state and deliveries of this organization.
alerting.evalError.timeout: The evaluation took longer than its time limit.
alerting.evalError.source_not_enabled: Data source not opted in to alerting
alerting.evalError.invalid_rule: The rule cannot be evaluated as stored.
alerting.evalError.wrong_shape: The result is {got}, the rule reduces {expected}.
alerting.evalError.nan: Field {field} is not a finite number.
alerting.evalError.duplicate_series: Two series have the same labels ({labels}).
alerting.evalError.truncated: The source cut the result, so the count is not certain.
alerting.evalError.truncatedBy: The source cut the result ({reason}), so the count is not certain.
alerting.evalError.no_paths: Counting paths, but the query returned none.
alerting.source.title: Alerting
alerting.source.lead: Whether alert rules may run on this data source.
alerting.source.readOnly: Whoever may edit this data source changes this.
alerting.source.optInText: The service identity “Alerting” may query this data source, read-only, within the source’s limits.
alerting.source.concurrentHint: At most this many rules query the data source at once (1 to 100); empty takes the server setting.
alerting.source.noRules: No rules on this data source.
alerting.source.revokeHint: Opting out: the {count} rules go to the state Error (“Data source not opted in to alerting”), and that is reported.
alerting.badge.title: Alert rules on “{panel}”
alerting.badge.hint: The threshold is dashed and the time a rule fired is a quiet area in the chart. Both can be hidden in the panel menu.
alerting.reason.alerts.datasource_not_op: The data source is not opted in to alerting.
alerting.reason.alerts.datasource_forbid: You may not query this rule’s data source, so you cannot change it.
alerting.reason.alerts.too_many_silences: The organization already has {max} active and planned silences.
alerting.reason.alerts.query_invalid: The query is missing, has too many steps or variables, or is larger than 64 KB.
alerting.reason.alerts.reduce_invalid: The reduce step does not fit the result shape.
alerting.reason.alerts.condition_invalid: The condition needs a number, or two bounds with “From” less than “To”.
alerting.reason.alerts.interval_invalid: The interval must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
alerting.reason.alerts.for_invalid: The “for” duration must be a multiple of the interval, at most {max} seconds.
alerting.reason.alerts.range_invalid: The range must be between 1 second and 30 days.
alerting.reason.alerts.state_option_inva: That state is not one of the choices.
alerting.reason.alerts.reminder_invalid: The reminder is off or between 1 minute and 7 days.
alerting.reason.alerts.labels_invalid: A label has a bad name or value, or there are more than 20.
alerting.reason.alerts.runbook_url_inval: The runbook must be an http or https address without a user name or password.
alerting.reason.alerts.panel_invalid: The panel of this rule is not valid.
alerting.reason.alerts.too_many_contact_: At most {max} contact points per rule.
alerting.reason.alerts.version_required: The version is missing; reload the rule.
alerting.reason.alerts.version_unexpecte: A new rule has no version yet.
alerting.reason.alerts.kind_invalid: A contact point is mail or webhook, and its kind cannot change.
alerting.reason.alerts.language_invalid: The language is German or English.
alerting.reason.alerts.webhook_url_inval: Enter an http or https address without a user name, password or fragment.
alerting.reason.alerts.webhook_url_kalzi: The address points at this Kalzit server.
alerting.reason.alerts.mail_not_configur: Mail needs a mail server (Administration > Email).
alerting.reason.alerts.contact_point_nam: Another contact point has this name.
alerting.reason.alerts.contact_point_in_: {rules} rules notify this contact point. Choose another one in those rules first.
alerting.reason.alerts.not_a_webhook: Only a webhook has a secret.
alerting.reason.alerts.matchers_invalid: Give 1 to 20 conditions, each with a label name and a value.
alerting.reason.alerts.matcher_regex_inv: A value after =~ is not a regular expression.
alerting.reason.alerts.silence_window_in: The silence must end in the future, at most 90 days from its start.
alerting.reason.alerts.status_invalid: That status is not one of the choices.
alerting.reason.alerts.history_kind_inva: That kind is not one of the choices.
alerting.reason.alerts.max_concurrent_in: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100, or leave it empty.
alerting.preview.noMessage: Nothing would be sent now: no instance fires, has no data or an error.
alerting.result.blocked: address refused by the target check
